why: The statement asks for exact k(n) in every dimension outside {1,2,3,4,8,24}; no event determines any k(n), so every lower- or upper-bound move is `bound` (F4) and the two structural Takhanov papers are `none`. Explicit finite configurations with supplied data/checkers are `checkable` (pairwise angle check is decisive); AlphaEvolve and PackingStar lack located coordinates and stay `unreviewed`; the 841 configuration rests on float output and is `doubtful`. AI roles are per-event: AlphaEvolve, PackingStar, Qiushi, Felpix and Long credit the systems with finding the constructions (`generated`); Ho (GPT-5.4 Pro used in the discovery) and Kravatskiy (developed working with Claude Code) are human-led with model contributions to the construction (`assisted`); Takhanov-Yun's result is built on PackingStar's configurations as starting points, which is AI-produced mathematics inside the final object, so `assisted` (close call vs none under F13). EinsteinArena has an empty systems list, so `none` per the rules.
doubts: EinsteinArena's 604 was by the record's prose produced by AI agents, but no system/quote was recorded in ai.systems, so it is answered `none`; a re-research could make it `generated`. README-based AI quotes (Felpix, Kravatskiy, Long) were read through a summariser. Felpix repository is undated (year 2026, still after snapshot). Value conflicts in dimensions 25-31 with the Cohn table are unresolved but do not affect scope.
